farms._weights: Farm pool weights are RELATIVE shares (EVM alloc-point style), not absolute percents of the emission rate. Worked example: with weights 7500 and 2000 and weeklyBoostPercent 5, of every 100 xSHARE the farms emit, 75 go to the xTOMB LP pool, 20 to the xSHARE LP pool, and 5 to the weekly loyalty boost. The split stays exact because the boost is weighted against the pools' combined weight. Weights are set by add_pool per pool; the program tracks the combined total for the carve-out.

note: Weekly loyalty boost — specs.md §8 (farms) and §18 (weekly loyalty reward), mirrored from the EVM ShareRewardPool build. The 5 percent is baked into the program's Config at initialize_config; no operator step turns it on. Every value here is a whole human unit — percents and days, never bps or base units. Program code converts.

weeklyBoost._activation: One-time operator step after initialize_config + create_mints + add_pool: call initialize_boost to create the boost state (anchored at the farm start). Until then the boost percent still applies to farm accrual, but no buckets accrue and Masonry staking needs no boost accounts; from initialize_boost on, Masonry stake/unstake must pass the boost accounts and eligibility tracking is live.
weeklyBoost._eligibility: Eligibility is Masonry stake ONLY (Jess, 2026-11-09: 'just masonry boost'). The farms fund the boost; only users who held LP stake in the Masonry pool for the whole prior week, with zero Masonry LP withdrawals that week, earn it. Farm-pool stake alone never qualifies. A staker's start-of-week stake is what earns; mid-week top-ups do not add to that week, mid-week entrants wait for their first full week, and any Masonry withdrawal — even dust — voids that week. A week with zero eligible stakers rolls its whole bucket into the next week. Claims are pull-based (claim_boost), pay no fee, and credit never expires.
weeklyBoost._weekLengthDays: Length of one loyalty week, in days. 7 = a calendar week. Loyalty weeks anchor at the farm start (Genesis end) and never drift. Settable with set_boost_config only BEFORE the farm start — it locks the moment the farm starts. Valid range 1-30 days. The 7-day progress bar in the app reads this same week.
weeklyBoost._weeklyBoostPercent: Percent of farm xSHARE emissions routed to the weekly loyalty boost, paid to users who held stake in the MASONRY pool for the whole prior week with zero Masonry LP withdrawals. 5 = five percent. Baked in as the Config default (Jess 2026-11-09); the admin may re-set it live with set_boost_config. Valid range 0-25; 0 turns the boost off. Changing it live is safe: accrual settles under the old percent first.
